title: Soppressata and Gruyère Puff Pastry
summary: Flaky puff pastry layered with Dijon, spicy soppressata and melty Gruyère; an easy party appetizer.
difficulty_reason: Just layer store-bought pastry with fillings, then bake and slice.

ingredients.line: 1 egg beaten with 1 tbsp water, for egg wash

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Lightly flour the counter, unfold one sheet of puff pastry, and set it on the lined pan.
Spread the Dijon mustard over the pastry, leaving a small border around the edge.
Overlap the soppressata slices in a single layer over the mustard.
Scatter the grated Gruyère evenly over the soppressata.
Lay the second pastry sheet on top, press the edges to seal, and brush the top with egg wash.
Cut a few slits in the top so steam can escape.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes, until deep golden and puffed.
Let it rest 10 minutes, then cut into squares and serve warm.
tips: All-butter puff pastry gives the richest flavor, but regular store-bought still bakes up crisp.
Ham works well in place of the soppressata.
